approval:
The foregoing project report entitled **“Smart Water Monitoring: Machine Learning and CPS for Safe & Sustainable Mining (JalDrishti)”** is hereby approved as a creditable piece of work carried out under the **UDAAN Fellowship Program**. The project has been completed and presented in a satisfactory manner and is considered worthy of acceptance as fulfilment of the requirements of the fellowship.

It is understood that by this approval, the undersigned do not necessarily endorse every conclusion drawn or opinion expressed therein, but approve the report for the purpose for which it is submitted.
